```
objective + current context and state
            │
            ▼
   model call: choose the next action
            │
            ▼
   structured tool request  ──or──  final response
            │
            ▼
   permission check / validation by surrounding software
            │
            ▼
   external execution (file read, command, search, ...)
            │
            ▼
   observation / evidence returned
            │
            ▼
   context and state updated
            │
            ▼
   next model call  ──►  continue, ask the user, or stop
```
